appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDescription: Pick a built-in theme or import a .rrtheme pack
appearance.desktopOnly: Theme pack import is only available in the desktop app
appearance.deleteConfirm: Delete theme "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
appearance.motionDescription: Control the intensity of UI animations and transitions

general.viewModeDescription: Default display mode of the ROM library
general.consoleDescription: Show or hide the bottom log console. Scan progress remains visible.

scanDirectories.title: ROM Libraries
scanDirectories.description: Each scan directory is an independent library. Click an item to make it active.
scanDirectories.scanThisLibrary: Activate and fully scan this library
scanDirectories.configDescription: Choose the immediate folders indexed by this library. Saving fully rescans the active library.
scanDirectories.addConfigDescription: Choose which immediate folders to index before the first scan.

storage.title: Storage Settings
storage.description: Review and manage disk usage for scraper cache and temporary work data
storage.temporaryWarning: Pending export data contains metadata and artwork that has not been exported. Cache cleanup never removes it.
storage.clearConfirm: This removes about {{size}} of provider results, candidate assets, and locally cached library images. ROM indexes and pending exports are preserved; source storage is read again when needed.
storage.orphanSummary: Found {{count}} assets not referenced by metadata in “{{library}}”, totaling {{size}}.
storage.orphanDetails: Scanned {{scanned}} assets and found {{indexed}} metadata references; safely skipped {{skipped}} system folders without valid metadata.
storage.orphanSafetyHint: Only explicit asset folders such as media, images, and artwork are checked. The app scans again before cleanup; ROMs, patches, and metadata files are never removed.

apiConfig.title: API Configuration
apiConfig.savedPasswordPlaceholder: Password saved; leave blank to keep it
apiConfig.screenScraperAuthHint: The app includes ScreenScraper developer credentials; only your username and password are required.
apiConfig.credentialsHint: Enter the provider API credentials. Credentials are stored only in the local configuration file.
apiConfig.rateLimitHint: These limits apply only to this provider and still respect server throttling responses.
apiConfig.mediaSelectionHint: Only checked assets are requested and cached. Videos and manuals are off by default. Up to 3 candidates per provider and type are cached.

aiTranslation.title: AI Metadata Translation
aiTranslation.description: Translate game titles, descriptions, companies, and genres through a custom OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint.
aiTranslation.targetLanguageHint: New configurations default to the interface language; you can enter any target language.
aiTranslation.reasoningHint: Uses the OpenAI-compatible reasoning_effort parameter. Gemini 3 generally cannot disable thinking completely; Minimal is recommended for metadata translation.
aiTranslation.mergeBatchHint: Entries are grouped by estimated token usage. No more than one eighth of the selected context is used for input to prioritize accuracy; failed or incomplete batches are split and retried automatically.
aiTranslation.savedKey: API key saved; leave blank to keep it
aiTranslation.securityHint: The API key is stored locally and requests are sent by the native backend. The custom endpoint must support /chat/completions.
aiTranslation.loadFailed: Failed to load AI translation settings: {{error}}
aiTranslation.saveFailed: Failed to save AI translation settings: {{error}}
